info.name: FastIPTV - Xtream Codes & App APIs
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for FastIPTV, covering the Xtream Codes API (Authentication, Live TV, VOD Movies, TV Series, EPG Guide, and Direct Stream Playback URLs) plus FastIPTV OTA Updates API.

### Quick Start:
1. Select the **FastIPTV Environment** or update the Collection Variables (`base_url`, `username`, `password`).
2. Run **01. Authentication & System -> Authenticate & Server Info** to verify your account status and credentials.
3. The test scripts will automatically save dynamic IDs (`live_category_id`, `live_stream_id`, `vod_category_id`, `vod_stream_id`, `series_id`, `episode_id`) into collection variables for subsequent requests.

### User-Agent Note:
All requests include `User-Agent: IPTVSmartersPro/1.0.0 (Linux;Android 11) ExoPlayerLib/2.18.2` which prevents IPTV providers from blocking requests with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
